disorder-name.detail: Alzheimer's disease patients from two external validation datasets (AIBL and MIRIAD). The normative and pathological lifespan models (HAVAs) were applied to these subjects as an external test cohort for AD vs. CN diagnosis.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "To validate our model, we built a testing dataset based on two open access databases (AIBL and MIRIAD) to perform AD versus CN diagnosis task."

dataset-of-origin.detail: AIBL: N=82 AD subjects; MIRIAD: N=46 AD subjects. Both are external validation datasets not used in training.
dataset-of-origin.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: Methods / Table 2 External dataset used for validation (N = 1,039)

age.detail: Weighted mean age computed from AIBL AD (N=82, mean=74.8) and MIRIAD AD (N=46, mean=69.3): (74.8×82 + 69.3×46) / 128 = 72.82 years. Min from AIBL (55.5), max from AIBL (93.4). SD not reported.
age.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: Methods / Table 2 External dataset used for validation (N = 1,039)

sex.detail: AIBL AD: F=47, M=36 (note: paper states N=82 but F+M=83, a 1-subject discrepancy in the paper); MIRIAD AD: F=27, M=19. Combined: F=74, M=55, total stated N=128. Percentages computed using stated total N=128: F%=74/128=57.8%, M%=55/128=43.0%. Due to paper discrepancy, F+M=129 ≠ 128.
sex.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: Methods / Table 2 External dataset used for validation (N = 1,039)

disorder-name.detail: Stable MCI: subjects from ADNI who remained MCI over a 3-year follow-up period (did not convert to AD within 36 months). Applied as an external prognostic test cohort.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "the MCI group was split into stable MCI (sMCI) over 3 years and progressive MCI (pMCI) who will convert to AD within 36 months following the baseline visit"

dataset-of-origin.detail: ADNI sMCI cohort (N=255) used as external validation for prognosis task (sMCI vs. pMCI).
dataset-of-origin.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: Methods / Table 2 External dataset used for validation (N = 1,039)
